Shot template

Your go-to shots, for every section. A shot template is a checklist of the shots you always want to get. Every shot below is added to every song section you pick, so you never forget coverage. Standard Shoot is ready to use. Edit it, or make your own and it's saved for next time.

Backup & transfer

Projects live only in this browser. Download a backup to keep a copy, or to move this project to another phone or computer. Reference images are included, so the file can be large. The track isn't included.
